What OS are you using? What version of Thunderbird are you using?

Using a browser, logon to your webmail account. Did you manage to logon to your webmail account? It's important to know because it confirms the password works.

Maybe it would be a good time to modify the current password whilst logged on to webmail account.

Did you modify/alter the account password?

Have you checked to see if there is an outage in your area ? There are a couple of people saying issues with Spectrum server, what area are you living in ? Maybe the others are in same area.

After the update, maybe you have a firewall which blocking access to latest Thunderbird.

Firewall: The Firewall might be the default that came with computer OR it might be controlled by an Anti-Virus product you installed.

  • Exit Thunderbird.
  • Access the Firewall and set up the Thunderbird program as an allowed program.
  • Confirm: Thunderbird is set up as an allowed program

What Anti-Virus are you using ? Some are well known for causing issues after an update or even if they have had an update and it's just a coincidence.
